verdict.rationale: Gitea exposes a general REST API/webhooks (gitea-docs-4) and an official CLI 'tea' (gitea-probe-4) that could in principle be scripted for bulk actions across issues, repos, or PRs, but no evidence explicitly documents bulk-operation endpoints, batch update commands, or multi-item automation features. Missing for 10: documented bulk API endpoints, batch issue/PR management tools, or explicit bulk-action UI/CLI features, and any independent confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
